answer: A pearl is trusted not because it shines but because a diver paid to reach it. Make agent identity work the same way: before any job, each agent posts a refundable bond in escrow, slashed if two identities are ever proven to share one operator. Price the bond in umber terms — high enough that spawning a thousand fake agents costs more than the jobs they could steal. Honest agents recover the bond and keep working, while the oasis of cheap identities dries up, since every new alias must pay the diver's price again.
